question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left back, Bob is playing striker, Claire is playing left midfielder, Dave is playing goalkeeper, Eve is playing benchwarmer, Fred is playing center midfielder, and Gertrude is playing left winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Bob trade positions. Finally, Dave and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) left back
(B) striker
(C) left midfielder
(D) goalkeeper
(E) benchwarmer
(F) center midfielder
(G) left winger
solution:
Each row lists positions in the order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (left back, striker, left midfielder, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, center midfielder, left winger)
1. Fred and Eve swap: (left back, striker, left midfielder, goalkeeper, center midfielder, benchwarmer, left winger)
2. Eve and Dave swap: (left back, striker, left midfielder, center midfielder, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, left winger)
3. Bob and Gertrude swap: (left back, left winger, left midfielder, center midfielder, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, striker)
4. Gertrude and Claire swap: (left back, left winger, striker, center midfielder, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, left midfielder)
5. Alice and Dave swap: (center midfielder, left winger, striker, left back, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, left midfielder)
6. Dave and Bob swap: (center midfielder, left back, striker, left winger, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, left midfielder)
7. Dave and Alice swap: (left winger, left back, striker, center midfielder, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, left midfielder)
Eve is playing goalkeeper, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
